description: For someone who bought an MCC app, course or paid tool and lost the email: sends the access link again to the address they bought with. Only that address receives anything, and the tool never says whether an address has an order. Use it when the person asked and gave that email (consent: true).

consent.description: true once the person asked for the link to be sent

email.description: The email address the purchase was made with

name: resend_download_link
title: Email a lost access link again
